Where will the next meteor appear? It is nearly impossible to know.

Watch a wide, dark sky. Sit somewhere comfy.
This NASA photo shows two showers: the Perseids and Alpha Capricornids.
The Leonids peak in mid-November each year, and again this week.

What the astronomers say: Leonid streaks trace back to the constellation Leo.

NASA picture: HQ, NHQ202508030001. NASA/Bill Ingalls, 3 Aug 2025.
